fact: Razorpay revenue from operations (FY23)
value: Rs 2,279 crore (up 53.88% YoY from Rs 841 crore in FY21, 2.7X in two years)

fact: Razorpay FY24 total revenue (incl. other income) and payment gateway revenue
value: Rs 2,501.4 crore total revenue (+9% YoY); Rs 2,068.1 crore from payment aggregation (83% of operating revenue, +24% YoY)

fact: Razorpay FY24 net profit (PAT)
value: Rs 34 crore, up ~4.5X (360%) YoY

fact: Razorpay annualized Total Payment Volume (TPV)
value: $180 billion annualized (as of Oct 2024), up from $150 billion in Feb 2024

fact: Razorpay total funding raised and latest valuation
value: Over $740 million raised; $7.5 billion valuation (Series F, Dec 2021, $375M round co-led by Lone Pine Capital, Alkeon Capital, TCV)

fact: Razorpay merchant base (approx.)
value: ~8 million businesses (2022-2024 estimates; company had targeted growth to 10 million by end of 2022)

fact: Razorpay reverse-flip domicile shift from US to India
value: Completed May 2025 (merger of Delaware-based Razorpay Inc. into Bengaluru-based Razorpay Software Pvt Ltd approved by MCA Regional Director), ahead of planned IPO

fact: RBI Payment Aggregator onboarding freeze and resolution
value: RBI halted new merchant onboarding for Razorpay, Cashfree, Stripe (Dec 2022); final PA authorization granted to Razorpay & Cashfree in Dec 2023, ending ~1-year freeze

fact: India digital payments transaction volume growth (RBI data)
value: Grew from 3,248 crore transactions (2019) to 20,849 crore (2024); digital payments were 99.7% of transaction volume in 2024

fact: UPI share of India's digital payments
value: Rose from 34% (2019) to 83% (2024) of total digital payment volume; 208.5 billion digital payment transactions recorded in India in 2024

fact: India Payment Gateway Market size and growth forecast
value: Valued at $1.9 billion in 2024, projected to reach $3.16 billion by 2030 (8.7% CAGR); broader "digital payment gateway market" definition sized at $16.2B (2024) to $32.96B (2030), 12.4% CAGR

fact: Cashfree Payments FY24 financials (key competitor)
value: Rs 643 crore revenue, Rs 133 crore loss in FY24; FY25 loss widened 14% to ~Rs 154 crore on flat/declining revenue

fact: PayU India (Prosus) FY24 financials (key competitor)
value: India PSP revenue $444 million (+11% YoY, slowed by RBI embargo), TPV +22% YoY; India contributes 46% of PayU's global PSP revenue and 60% of TPV; works with 500,000+ businesses; PSP trading margin was -3% in FY24 (vs +3% in FY23)

fact: MSME formal credit access gap in India
value: Only 14% of India's MSMEs have access to formal credit (Deloitte); only 19% of MSME credit demand met through formal sources (Statista)

fact: India MSME Udyam registration growth
value: Over 6.2 crore MSMEs registered on Udyam portal by March 2025, up from 2.5 crore as of March 2024

fact: MSME digital adoption gap
value: Over 90% of MSMEs accept digital payments, but only 18% have accessed credit via digital lending platforms and only 13% actively use digital marketing/e-commerce

fact: Tier 2/3 city e-commerce and UPI growth
value: ~60% of India's e-commerce shoppers come from Tier 2/3 cities; UPI usage in these regions surged 118%; India's e-retail market has reached $60 billion

fact: UPI P2M transactions carry zero MDR (regulatory cap on core monetization)
value: MDR is 0% on bank-to-bank UPI (P2M) transactions regardless of amount; only RuPay Credit Card on UPI carries interchange/MDR of ~1.1%-1.99%, with small offline merchants exempt on transactions ≤₹2,000

fact: Razorpay offline expansion via Ezetap acquisition and new hardware
value: Acquired Ezetap (Aug 2022), rebranded as Razorpay POS; launched budget soundbox priced Rs 450-850 and two-screen POS device at Global Fintech Fest 2024 to challenge Paytm/BharatPe/Pine Labs

fact: Razorpay international expansion (Malaysia via Curlec)
value: Acquired Curlec in Malaysia (Feb 2022); launched first international payment gateway (July 2023) targeting RM10 billion annualized GTV by 2025, serving 5,000+ businesses; eyeing Indonesia, Vietnam, Philippines next
